title: Order Granting Extension (Docket No. 23-2643-01)
text:
- BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION OF UTAH - 

Application of Mountain Green Mutual 
Water Company for Exemption 

DOCKET NO. 23-2643-01 

ORDER GRANTING EXTENSION 

ISSUED: September 25, 2024 

On April 22, 2024, the Public Service Commission (PSC) issued a scheduling 
order establishing deadlines in this docket, including that non-applicant written direct 
testimony was due on August 26, 2024. On September 9, 2024, intervenor Highlands 
Water Company, Inc. (“Highlands”) filed a motion seeking to extend the deadline for 
the submission of its written direct testimony to September 10, 2024 (“Motion for 
Extension”). Highlands included the written direct testimony of three witnesses with 
the filing of its Motion for Extension (“Written Testimony”). 

Although not explicitly stated in the Motion for Extension, it appears that 
Highlands did not meet the August 26, 2024, deadline because of ongoing settlement 
discussion between Highlands and applicant Mountain Green Mutual Water Company 
(“MGMWC”) which, according to the Motion for Extension, were unsuccessful in 
resolving their differences.1 Neither MGMWC nor the Division of Public Utilities 
opposed or otherwise responded to the Motion for Extension.2 

Good cause supports the Motion for Extension, and it is not opposed. The 
Motion for Extension is granted and the Written Testimony is accepted pursuant to this 
order. 

1 See Motion for Extension at 1-2. 
2 See Utah Admin. Rule R746-1-301.
